components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that moves the user forward in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, scale 150ms; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { scale: 0.96; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: An alternative action that is not destructive.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, scale 150ms; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--secondary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { scale: 0.96; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Erasing something: outlined, red text, hovering on a red wash.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, scale 150ms; background: transparent; color: var(--destructive); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 15%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { scale: 0.96; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: A 32px ghost button with one icon; a toggle that is on takes the color of what it means.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Pin to top" aria-pressed="false"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 17v5"/><path d="M9 10.76a2 2 0 0 1-1.11 1.79l-1.78.9A2 2 0 0 0 5 15.24V16a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-.76a2 2 0 0 0-1.11-1.79l-1.78-.9A2 2 0 0 1 15 10.76V7a1 1 0 0 1 1-1 2 2 0 0 0 0-4H8a2 2 0 0 0 0 4 1 1 0 0 1 1 1z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, scale 150ms; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 50%, transparent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-icon-btn:active { scale: 0.96; } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.description: Switches between the two lists of a screen; each option carries its count.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--muted); } .ds-segmented-option { padding: 4px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 12px/1.33 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-segmented-option:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 50%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-segmented-option[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-segmented-option:active { scale: 0.96; } .ds-segmented-option:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A text field with a magnifier; the border and a soft ring turn blue on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; width: 320px; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 10px; translate: 0 -50%; display: flex; color: var(--muted-foreground); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 32px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 30%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px/1.43 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Navigation Tabs
components.description: The bar at the top of the window; the current tab has a blue underline.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Main"><button class="ds-tab" aria-current="page"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9H4.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0-5H6"/><path d="M18 9h1.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 0-5H18"/><path d="M4 22h16"/><path d="M10 14.66V17c0 .55-.47.98-.97 1.21C7.85 18.75 7 20.24 7 22"/><path d="M14 14.66V17c0 .55.47.98.97 1.21C16.15 18.75 17 20.24 17 22"/><path d="M18 2H6v7a6 6 0 0 0 12 0V2Z"/></svg>Game</button><button class="ds-tab">Dashboard</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); width: 320px; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: -1px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.43 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 50%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] { border-bottom-color: var(--primary); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-tab:active { scale: 0.98; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: A round track filled in blue, or green for something finished; the number sits beside it.
components.css: .ds-progress-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 320px; } .ds-progress { flex: 1; height: 6px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--secondary); } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); transition: width 300ms; } .ds-progress-count { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 12px/1.33 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Achievement Card
components.description: The unit the app is built around: icon, name, rarity, description, counter and the row of tools.
components.html:
It’s Shaling Outside

0,6%

Survive the dreaded rain of boulders.

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; gap: 12px; width: 420px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.43 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-card-icon { display: flex; flex: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-card-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; } .ds-card-title { flex: 1; margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-card-rarity, .ds-card-count { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 2px 0 0; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 75%, transparent); } .ds-card-progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-card-track { flex: 1; height: 6px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--secondary); } .ds-card-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); } .ds-card-tools { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-top: 10px; } .ds-card-tool { height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font: 500 12px/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, scale 150ms; } .ds-card-tool:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--secondary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-card-tool:active { scale: 0.96; } .ds-card-tool:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Second Monitor"**

Trophy Tracker is a support panel, not a destination. It sits beside a game on a second screen, in a window 600 pixels wide, and is read in glances by someone whose attention is elsewhere. Everything in the system follows from that: a dark field that does not glow next to a game, dense rows that put a whole list in view, one accent that marks what can be acted on, and controls small enough to stay out of the way.

The palette is borrowed from the place the user already lives. The navy field, the light blue accent and the lime green of a finished achievement are Steam's own, so the panel reads as part of the same desk rather than a second product asking to be learned. The identity is in the restraint and the response: surfaces are flat and told apart by tone, and every control answers a touch at once.

Motion is short and small. A screen rises 6 pixels as it appears, a list fades in, a section grows to its height. Nothing loops for attention, with one exception: the dot that says a game is running.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, on a navy field that sits quietly beside a game.
Dense and narrow: built for 600 pixels of width, never under 480.
Flat surfaces separated by tone and a hairline border; shadow only on what floats.
One accent, used for what can be acted on and what is in focus.
Compact controls that respond to every touch: a tint on hover, a small push on press, a visible ring on keyboard focus.
Numbers are tabular, so counters and percentages do not shift as they change.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only color that means "you can act here" or "you are here". If it appears on something that is neither, it is wrong.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green is done, amber is set apart, red is loss. None of them is ever used for decoration or to add variety to a list.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: Hover is a translucent wash of Hover Steel (40 to 50 percent) over whatever is underneath, not a new opaque color. Red text never sits on that wash, because it fails contrast; a destructive control hovers on a 15 percent wash of Erase Red instead.

rules.name: The Same Size Rule
rules.body: A title and its description share one size. Weight and opacity do the work, which keeps a card short enough for a list to stay in view.

rules.name: The Steady Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change (percentages, counters, counts, progress) is set in tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: If it scrolls with the page, it has no shadow. Tone and a hairline separate it from what is around it.

dos: Do keep every screen readable at 600 pixels and usable at 480, and check it in Spanish and French before calling it done.
Do separate surfaces with tone and a one-pixel Hairline Slate border.
Do draw one line between two things and none at the end of a group; two lines in a row, or a line next to a border, is a mistake.
Do give every clickable element three visible states besides rest: a wash on hover, a push on press (96 percent, or 99 percent for wide elements), and a focus ring.
Do use Signal Blue only for what can be acted on or what is current.
Do set every number that can change in tabular figures.
Do make a scrolling container the containing block of what is inside it (`relative`): visually hidden text is absolutely positioned and would otherwise give the window a second scrollbar.
Do show remote images in a fixed-size box with a skeleton while loading and an icon on failure.
Do animate only entrances, in 200ms or less, and let the reduced-motion preference turn them off.
donts: Don't add a light theme or a pure white or pure black surface.
Don't put a shadow on anything that scrolls with the page.
Don't use green, amber or red for decoration or to tell list items apart.
Don't place red text on the usual hover wash; use the red wash.
Don't use a native select or the native `title` tooltip: the first opens a system popup that cannot be themed, the second is slow and never shows on keyboard focus.
Don't introduce a second typeface, or a display size above 20px anywhere but the completion figure.
Don't make a control that only appears on hover unreachable by keyboard; it must also appear on focus.
Don't animate an exit, loop an animation for attention, or move anything more than 20 pixels.
